hero.lede: The first board game company built entirely in the open. CC-licensed rules, forkable engines, and games designed to be taken apart.

gallery.heading: Browse our collection or pick a game you own

rules_card.heading: Every rule in a git repo
rules_card.body: 24 game families, 147 variants, printable PDFs, and board diagrams. All open-licensed, all forkable.

featured.heading: Hyper Imperium
featured.body: Our homebrew for Twilight Imperium 4e + Prophecy of Kings. Hyper Movement, Hyper Trades, Hyper Objectives, Hyper Factions, Hyper Agendas — a faster ruleset that keeps the politics intact.

dev_band.heading: Board game engines as AI tools
dev_band.body: {{counts.ai_tools}} AI-callable tools for chess variant analysis, hex map generation, and board game utilities. Connect from Claude, Cursor, or VS Code in one command. Or build bots for Telegram, Slack, and Discord.

nukes.heading: Are you ready to nuke Catan?
nukes.body: Cold-war hex strategy with no dice and no luck. Return hostages to move, but every return reinforces your enemy. 45 million Catan owners already have the board.
nukes.image_alt: Family playing a board game with a mushroom cloud

community_band.heading: Mod a game with us
community_band.body: Designers, playtesters, and rule-tinkerers building open-source board games together. Pitch a mod, test someone else's, or just argue about Catan's longest road rule.
